findings.title: Negative (and zero-ish/-infinite) litres are accepted and saved
findings.where: POST /api/waterings; Beds page 'Record past watering' form
findings.steps: On Beds, open 'Record past watering', enter -5 litres and save. Or POST {"bed_id":1,"watered_on":"2026-11-01","litres":-5}.
findings.expected: Refused with a visible reason (amount must be greater than zero); API answers 422.
findings.actual: API returns 201 and stores litres -5. The client check only rejects exactly 0 (litres === 0), so negatives pass, even though its message says 'greater than zero'. -1e308 is also saved, and '-Infinity' is saved and comes back as null. The schema has le=10000 but no lower bound.
findings.evidence: POST litres:-5 -> 201 {"litres":-5.0}; litres:-1e308 -> 201; litres:"-Infinity" -> 201 litres:null. The Waterings list then shows '-5 L' and the totals are wrong (negative totals hide the total text).

findings.title: Watering date has no lower bound (year 0001 accepted)
findings.expected: An implausibly old date is refused with a reason.
findings.actual: 201 Created. The watering is stored dated 1 Jan 0001.

findings.title: Oversized integer ids give a 500
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (plain text). Reachable from the UI through /waterings?bed=99999999999999999999.
findings.evidence: All three requests returned 'Internal Server Error 500'

findings.title: Error states for waterings have no retry
findings.steps: Make /api/waterings fail (for example, stop the API) and open the dashboard or /waterings.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that refetches without a reload.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown. The dashboard does not even destructure refresh for waterings, and /waterings offers no retry control. The user has to reload the page.
findings.evidence: index.vue: `const { data: waterings, error: wateringsError } = wateringsResult` with no retry button in the template; waterings.vue shows the AlertMessage with no button.

findings.title: Beds fetch failure on Waterings page is silent
findings.steps: Make /api/beds fail while /api/waterings works, then open /waterings.
findings.expected: An error saying the beds could not be loaded, with a retry.
findings.actual: bedsResult.error is ignored. The filter dropdown shows only 'All beds' with no explanation, and a bed preselected from ?bed= shows as a blank selection.
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: `const { data: beds } = bedsResult`; the error is never rendered

findings.title: 'Water now' retry after a timeout or network failure records duplicate waterings
findings.steps: Click 'Water now'. If the response is lost or slow and the user clicks again, or presses Save watering again after an error, each click inserts a new row.
findings.expected: A retry of the same action makes one change (idempotency key or dedupe).
findings.actual: There is no idempotency key, and the server inserts unconditionally. Requests also have no 10 s timeout, so the button can stay on 'Watering…' indefinitely while the server hangs.
findings.evidence: recordWatering calls api('/waterings', {method:'POST', body}) with no timeout or key; create_watering always INSERTs

findings.title: Deleting an already-deleted watering shows an error
findings.steps: Delete a watering in two tabs, or retry after a timeout.
findings.expected: Treated as done; the list refreshes.
findings.actual: 404 'Watering not found.' is shown as an error, and the list is not refreshed.
findings.evidence: A second DELETE /api/waterings/3 returned 404 {"detail":"Watering not found."}
